subject: Renewal QBR + Roadmap: consolidated half-day format — timing proposal
messages:
From: Clara Moss <clara.moss@medicorp.io>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Medicorp Renewal QBR — condensed format question

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well. As we approach our renewal window (Q3), our execs have asked if we can compress the usual multi-session QBR into a single, half-day session that combines the renewal discussion, roadmap preview, and a short hands-on lab for our engineers. The goals are:
- Align on contract terms and renewal timeline
- Get a clear view of the 12-month roadmap and migration path for our high-volume inference workloads
- Validate a short integration lab (30–45m) so our infra team can surface blockers early

Constraints: execs can only do early mornings PT (08:00–11:00 PT) on weekdays; engineering prefers later mornings. Procurement will request the SOC2 + data handling evidence ahead of the meeting.

Can you propose 2–3 candidate half-day dates in June? Also, can you confirm expected Redwood attendees (we’ll pull our attendee list after we lock timing).

Thanks,
Clara Moss
Head of Cloud Platforms | Medicorp
Clara.moss@medicorp.io

(Attachment: medicinal-priorities.pdf)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Clara Moss <clara.moss@medicorp.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Medicorp Renewal QBR — condensed format question

Clara — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely run a consolidated half-day. Proposed approach:

Agenda (high level, attached): 
- 09:00–09:20: Welcome + renewal framing (exec sponsors)
- 09:20–10:00: Roadmap highlights relevant to Medicorp (product + infra)
- 10:00–10:15: Break
- 10:15–11:00: Integration lab (walkthrough + hands-on)
- 11:00–11:45: Migration options / cost-performance tradeoffs
- 11:45–12:00: Action items & procurement next steps

Candidate dates: June 16 (preferred) or June 22 — both mornings PT. We can shift start to 08:30 PT if execs need earlier.

We’ll include: Marissa (CS lead) to run the lab, David (Security) to handle compliance questions, and I’ll run the renewal portion. We’ll also run a 30-minute canary mini-run the same morning at 08:15–08:45 PT for your infra team if that helps.

Attaching a proposed agenda PDF. Would you be able to confirm: expected attendee roles (exec / procurement / infra) and whether you want the lab to be a laptop-based hands-on or a demo-led environment?

Thanks — I’ll loop in a couple more Redwood folks after your reply.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: renewal-qbr-proposed-agenda.pdf)
